'''Kodom''' was a [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and the co-leader of the [[Shrine Restoration Initiative]], an organization created to rebuild the shrines and temples of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] following the [[Invasion of Voss]]. As the representative of his species, he valued integrity and hoped to improve his people's standing.<ref name="TOR" />
